Configure PaddleOCR language, model tier, and model version

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	xberg "github.com/xberg-io/xberg/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	input := xberg.ExtractInput{
		Kind:     ptr(xberg.ExtractInputKindURI),
		URI:      ptr(`https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png`),
		MimeType: ptr(`image/png`),
	}
	config := xberg.ExtractionConfig{
		Ocr: &xberg.OcrConfig{
		Enabled:         ptr(true),
		Backend:         `paddleocr`,
		PaddleOcrConfig: ptr(json.RawMessage(`{"language":"en","model_tier":"mobile","model_version":"pp-ocrv6"}`)),
	},
	}
	result, err := xberg.Extract(input, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Results[0].Content)
}
```
